# `compat/runtime-realm.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/runtime-realm.js`

runtime-realm.js — a controlled, scoped execution root for a guest app. Trusted same-origin guests (Mode A/B) reference elements via `document.*`, so the realm is a SCOPED LIGHT-DOM container (`<div data-engine-app="id">`) rather than a shadow root — `getElementById('c')` must still resolve. Isolation comes from: • CSS scoping (css-healer) so guest styles can't touch the OS shell, • API interposition (Phase 5) so guest browser calls route through the engine, • DOM healing so required elements exist before scripts run. Scripts parsed by DOMParser are inert; the realm re-executes them in document order: classic inline → fresh <script>; module inline → blob import(); src → resolved against the package file map (blob) or left as a URL for the browser.
